title: Normalized quotient presentation of the cohomology image graded piece
statement: Let C be an abelian category, K a cochain complex and L a decreasing filtration. For integers p,n, define A=L.complexStep p n, A' = L.complexStep (p+1) n, Z=ker(K.d n (n+1)), B=im(K.d (n-1) n), and let q be the degree-n map from L^pK to its graded quotient. Let Zbar and Bbar be the images under q of the pullback of (A∩Z)+A' and (A∩B)+A'. Then Bbar≤Zbar and the graded piece of the cohomology image filtration is isomorphic to cokernel(Bbar→Zbar).

source.place: Intermediate normalized cycle and boundary quotient calculation in the proof.

proof.text: Identify the image filtration graded piece with the cokernel of the inclusion of the next image step into the current image step, and identify those image steps with the normalized cycle and boundary subobjects under the degree-n graded projection. The boundary inclusion follows from d²=0 and filtration antitonicity. The first isomorphism theorem yields the stated quotient.

lean.statement:
theorem cohomologyImage_graded_normalized
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    {K : CochainComplex C ℤ} (L : DecreasingFiltration K) (p n : ℤ) :
  let A := L.complexStep p n
  let A' := L.complexStep (p + 1) n
  let Z := (Subobject.pullback (K.d n (n + 1))).obj ⊥
  let B := imageSubobject (K.d (n - 1) n)
  let q := (L.complexQuotientπ p (p + 1) (Int.le_add_one le_rfl)).f n
  let P := Subobject.pullback ((L.step p).arrow.f n)
  let Zbar := (Subobject.«exists» q).obj (P.obj ((A ⊓ Z) ⊔ A'))
  let Bbar := (Subobject.«exists» q).obj (P.obj ((A ⊓ B) ⊔ A'))
  ∃ hBZ : Bbar ≤ Zbar,
    Nonempty ((L.cohomologyImage n).gradedPiece p ≅
      cokernel (Subobject.ofLE Bbar Zbar hBZ))
